options.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.

steps.player: Can you heal me? I'm injured.

steps.text: Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.

options.text: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?

steps.player: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?

steps.npc: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!

options.text: How do I get further into the monastery?
options.condition: If the player has not joined the Edgeville Monastery order:

steps.player: How do I get further into the monastery?

steps.npc: I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.

options.text: Well can I join your order?

steps.player: Well can I join your order?

steps.text: If the player does not have 31 prayer:

steps.npc: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.

steps.text: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.

steps.npc: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.

options.text: Can you help with spirit shields?

steps.npc: I might be able to... What did you have in mind?

steps.player: Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?

steps.npc: I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.

steps.text: Abbot Langley carefully breaks each shield, leaving the sigils perfectly intact.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-s.npc: Only members of our order can go up there.

options.text: Well can I join your order?

steps.player: Well can I join your order?

steps.text: If the player does not have 31 prayer:

steps.npc: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.

steps.text: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.

steps.npc: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.

claiming-the-corrupted-helm.npc: Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!

claiming-the-corrupted-helm.text: Abbot Langley quickly takes the soft clay, leather boots and bowl of hot water in exchange for a mysterious helmet.

treasure-trails-hard.text: If the player has finished the treasure trail:
If the player has not finished the treasure trail:

steps.text: Abbot Langley has given you another clue scroll!

treasure-trails-master.text: If the player has no free inventory spaces:

steps.npc: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!

treasure-trails-master.text: If the player has at least one free inventory space:

steps.text: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.

treasure-trails-master.npc: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.

delivering-a-letter-from-the-wise-old-ma.player: I've got a message for you from your friend in Draynor Village.

delivering-a-letter-from-the-wise-old-ma.npc: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!

delivering-a-letter-from-the-wise-old-ma.text: If the player does not have enough space in their inventory for a reward:

steps.npc: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.

delivering-a-letter-from-the-wise-old-ma.text: If the player has at least one space in their inventory for a reward:

steps.text: Abbot Langley gives you some banknotes that can be exchanged for herbs.

steps.npc: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.

steps.text: Abbot Langley blesses you. You gain some prayer xp.

steps.npc: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
